title.zh: 将北苏里高省 Surigao 市 Cantiasay 描笼涯的 Zaragosa 国立学校附属校分离，改设为独立的 Cantiasay 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Zaragosa National School-Cantiasay Annex in Barangay Cantiasay, City of Surigao, Province of Surigao Del Norte From the Zaragosa National School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Cantiasay National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Zaragosa National School-Cantiasay Annex in Barangay Cantiasay, City of Surigao, Province of Surigao Del Norte From the Zaragosa National School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Cantiasay National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Cantiasay của Trường Zaragosa Quốc gia tại Barangay Cantiasay, Thành phố Surigao, Tỉnh Surigao Del Norte khỏi Trường Zaragosa Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Cantiasay Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Cantiasay ของโรงเรียน Zaragosa แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Cantiasay เมือง Surigao จังหวัด Surigao Del Norte ออกจากโรงเรียน Zaragosa แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Cantiasay แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Cantiasay, Sekolah Zaragosa Nasional di Barangay Cantiasay, Kota Surigao, Provinsi Surigao Del Norte dari Sekolah Zaragosa Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cantiasay Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Cantiasay, Sekolah Zaragosa Kebangsaan di Barangay Cantiasay, Bandar Surigao, Wilayah Surigao Del Norte daripada Sekolah Zaragosa Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cantiasay Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Zaragosa National School – Cantiasay Annex in Barangay Cantiasay, City of Surigao, Province of Surigao del Norte is hereby separated from the.Zaragosa National School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Cantiasay National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Zaragosa National School - Cantiasay Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Cantiasay National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Cantiasay National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Zaragosa National School - Cantiasay Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
